_comment: BUILDPLAN-ANALYZER-005Q-OCR fixed sample (development only; no blind, no holdout draw). Frozen before any contender ran. One floor-plan sheet per row, identified by its observation-graph frame and the sealed variant bytes' SHA-256 (the bytes stay outside Git: /home/user/work005o/byte-index.json maps the hash to the cache file). Roles: FAILURE = a mandatory forensic anchor of the brief; CONTROL = a known-good development row (positive/negative control). 'lineage' groups sheets that are copies of the same drawing: they count as ONE independent family. 'smoke' marks the single sheet used for the feasibility smoke test and detector-scale choice; it is scored but reported separately as a tuning sheet.
